moves.title: From idea to licensed business in three moves

m1.title: Describe your idea
m1.text: In your language, by text or voice. Tiva asks a few questions: sector, province, size, where you are from.

m2.title: Get your roadmap
m2.text: Every step in order — who approves it, what to file — with the law behind it. Download it as a PDF.

m3.title: Meet the right people
m3.text: One tap to a lawyer, APIEX or the licensing one-stop shop, with your summary already attached.

covers.title: What Tiva covers
covers.lead: The questions investors actually ask, answered from Mozambican legislation.

law.title: Built on the law, checked by lawyers
law.text: Every answer shows the legislation it rests on and the date it was last reviewed. Nothing goes live until a Mozambican lawyer approves it. Tiva gives general information, not legal advice — for your specific case, talk to an expert.
